Package com.arthroverse.vf17.utilities

Interface AlertUtil

public interface AlertUtil
Utility interface that provides reusable helper methods for displaying JavaFX alert dialogs related to exception handling and error reporting.

This utility ensures that all UI-related alert operations are executed safely on the JavaFX Application Thread by using Platform.runLater(Runnable).

The interface is designed to be stateless and provides only static methods.

  • Method Details

    • generateExceptionViewer

      static void generateExceptionViewer(String stackTraceAsString, String title)
      Displays an error alert dialog that shows a detailed exception stack trace to the user in a reusable UI container.

      This method is thread-safe and can be called from any background thread. Internally, it delegates the UI rendering logic to the JavaFX Application Thread using Platform.runLater(Runnable).

      Parameters:
      stackTraceAsString - the stack trace of the exception formatted as a String
      title - the header text displayed at the top of the alert dialog

    • generateExceptionString

      static String generateExceptionString(Throwable t)
      Converts a Throwable into a formatted stack trace string.

      This method is typically used to capture detailed exception information for logging or for displaying in an error dialog via generateExceptionViewer(String, String).

      Parameters:
      t - the Throwable whose stack trace is to be converted
      Returns:
      a String containing the full stack trace of the exception
